title: Contact & appointments
subtitle: Coordination by WhatsApp. I listen before we schedule.
disclaimer: A photo isn't enough to quote a plan seriously. The Diagnostic & Planning Consultation is where I think through your case with you — not where I sell you a procedure.

sections.heading: Best way to reach me
sections.body: WhatsApp is the fastest channel for questions, availability, and scheduling. For formal invoices or referrals, email works too. If your case is complex, send me a brief note before booking — it helps me prepare.

sections.heading: Hours
sections.note: By appointment. I'm not at the office all day — we agree on a time that works for you.

sections.heading: Location & access
sections.body: Ometz Dental — Auditores de la Guerra del Chaco 617, Barrio Mburucuyá, Asunción, Paraguay. Two minutes walking from Mburucuyá's main plaza; access and parking directions go out when we schedule.

sections.heading: Availability
sections.body: Accepting new patients. Opening before 26 July 2026 (soft launch). First appointments usually available within the first or second week after opening.
